{{Otheruses|Blaze}}
A '''blaze-cutlass''' was a type of [[cutlass]] favored by [[pirate]]s.<ref name="IA">{{WEGCite|story=The Treasure of Celis Mott|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref><ref name="OS">[[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]</ref>

Comparable in power to a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] or [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]], the blaze-cutlass was an uncommon weapon that dealt both physical and energy damage.<ref name="OS" /> Notably used by the famous [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Celis Mott]],<ref name="OS" /> a [[Unidentified Wookiee pirate|Wookiee]] member of the [[Nanth'ri Pirates]] wielded one as well.<ref name="IA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The statistics for the blaze-cutlass in Otherspace show no STR modifier (4D+1) alluding to it be at least partially an energy weapon; likewise, in Instant Adventures, the stats show it to be primarily a STR based weapon with an energy component (STR+2D). The exact specifics of the weapon, aside from it being a sword, are unknown.
